 Millie Bobby Brown goes Barbie pink in cropped skirt set for date night with husband Jake Bongiovi 
 By 
 Avery Matera 
 Published 
 Oct. 21, 2026, 1:33 p.m. ET 
 See more of our coverage in your search results. 
 Make Page Six a Preferred Source 
 Millie Bobby Brown is enjoying the warmer fall weather in NYC.
 The actress was spotted leaving celeb-loved hotspot The Corner Store with husband Jake Bongiovi on Tuesday night wearing a matching three-piece suede set from Modalità Vacanza.
 The look included a sleeveless, naval-baring top ($114) with a low-slung midi skirt ($237) that showed off her abs.

 Milly Bobby Brown and husband Jake Bongiovi were spotted out on a date night in NYC on Tuesday. BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID 
 5 
 The actress chose head-to-toe Barbie pink for the night out. BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID 
 5 
 Bongiovi, hand in hand, opted for a monochromatic palette as well. BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID

 She paired it with a matching trucker jacket ($245) made of the same pink faux suede, slipping into hot pink Louis Vuitton slingback heels and slipping a black Gucci bag ($3,100) around her wrist.
 Her husband, meanwhile, went monochromatic too in a navy polo and matching trousers.
 Brown is clearly embracing pink this season; her Florence by Mills fashion brand introduced a collection of loungewear last month September in the same shade.
 5 
 Brown styled her pink crop top set with hot pink heels and a black bag. BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID 
 5 
 The couple, who have been married since May 2024, just confirmed in September that they have welcomed their second child. BlayzenPhotos / BACKGRID 
 Brown and Bongiovi have been married since May 2024 , announcing in September that they announced their second child.
 Last month, a source exclusively shared with Page Six that Brown is “much more of a homebody these days and would rather spend time with Jake and the kids than be out partying,” adding, “She’s still young and likes to have fun, but her priorities have shifted … She’s really enjoying this chapter of her life and having a family of four.”
 The Bongiovi’s clearly enjoyed a chic dinner for two.
